lb-unproven-wins: cells where our bound exceeds K's derived dual bound, of the K-unproven arm at n20
lb-unproven-mean-ratio: mean ours/K dual bound over the K-unproven n20 arm
budget-sensitivity: share of the terminal bound held at a fraction of each cell's own budget
wls-sensitivity: our arithmetic bound vs K best-known across their four cost scenarios
lb-dual-wilcoxon: paired test of our bound against K's derived dual, K-unproven cells at n20 and n30
lb-proven-pct-range: our bound as a share of the proven optimum, K-proven n20 cells
objective-identity-match: K-proven n20 optima we reproduce at their reported precision
tw-ratio-by-family-n50: mean time-window width over horizon, by family at n50
s2k-closure: S2k: what our bound is worth to an exact solver on three open cells
rc208-one-car: the RC208/n20 one-vehicle outlier: value, comparator, mechanism
one-car-cells-n20: |C|=20 cells for which we hold a one-vehicle solution
r205-one-car-optimal: R205/n20: a one-vehicle solution, proven optimal
transfer-duration-by-family: transfer duration U resolved by K's published rule, by instance family
cross-size-share: our bound as a share of K best-known, n50 vs n100, one construction
milp-over-kbk-by-family-n100: restriction bound as a share of K best-known, by family at n100
protocol: protocol constants read from the artifacts, not typed
ab-tightens-k-gaps: cells where the arithmetic bound exceeds K's published dual bound, and the gap reduction that follows
ab-over-kbk-by-family-n50: arithmetic bound as a share of K best-known, by family at n50
n50-ratio-vs-k: portfolio bound over K's derived dual bound at n50
gap-closed-by-family: share of K's closable gap that our portfolio bound closes, and the nominal gain, by family and size
lb-time-to-exceed-k: wall seconds until our bound first exceeds K's derived dual bound, K-unproven cells
lb-over-kdual-n100: our portfolio bound over K's derived dual bound, by family at n100
ab-crossovers-by-size: cells where the arithmetic bound exceeds the restriction bound
descent-cost-multiplier: median wall-time multiplier per step down in k, n20
budget-below-frontier: median share of a cell's budget spent on solves that never certify, n20
fleet-certificate-coverage: cells where one vehicle is proved impossible, by size
s3a-easiness-winrate: informative cells where the easiness ordering gives the stronger frontier bound, per arm
s3a-wilcoxon-p: exact one-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank p on log frontier ratios, easiness vs arm
s3a-mean-frontier-ratio: mean arm/easiness frontier bound ratio over informative cells
s3a-friedman-p: Iman-Davenport F p-value, three arms over informative cells
s3a-holm-adjusted-p: Holm step-down adjusted p against the easiness control
s3a-average-rank: mean Friedman rank of each arm (1 = strongest bound)
s3a-informative-cells: cells entering the ablation after the pre-registered k=0 exclusion
m6-matched-budget: M6: our bound against K's LBBD reproduced at a budget matched to K's own per-cell incumbent time
m7-matched-budget-n30: M7: the |C|=30 arm of the matched-budget reproduction, the registered falsifier of beats-both-k-bounds-v3
n20-fleet-total: |C|=20 street-fleet total against the total K's published mean implies
tep-n10-attainment: |C|=10: attainment of the 27 K-proven optima by the TEP primal (per-cell best-of)
tep-n20-split: |C|=20: PROVEN (7) attainment and OPEN (20) competition, with the open-cell bracket and bound comparison
tep-n30-split: |C|=30: PROVEN (1) attainment and OPEN (26) competition, with the open-cell bracket and bound comparison
tep-n30-fine-delta: |C|=30: the finer-bucket (d=5) bound leg -- cells proven and the median lift over the default width
tep-n50-pool: |C|=50: our 27-cell mean against the K pool the instances belong to (Table 4, 1:10); pooled, proximity inferred
tep-n100-family: |C|=100: family means of our verified primal against K published family means; bound columns only where certified
tep-coverage: which K exhibits the TEP results cover and which stay uncovered
tep-bound-calibration: bound quality against GROUND TRUTH: distance of our certified bound below the proven optimum, by size, with the share of the objective one car costs
tep-abstract: every quantity the ABSTRACT asserts, from analysis/abstract_facts.py -- their proofs and published averages, our attainment over all 35 proven cells, the open-cell brackets at every size, which end closes the interval, and the budget
